findings.message: dataflow: L_train is defined as (1/(T_exec,m*|J_m|))*sum_u sum_j[((y_tilde[Q|Q,u,j]-y_tilde[BF16|Q,u,j])/s[m,j])^2]; s[m,j]>0 keeps each channel scaled dimensionlessly, and all u=1..T_exec,m remain included. By contrast, V_visit still sums over j without a time index/reduction although E_m returns the native executed prefix, so its task-level diagnostic is not explicitly scalar. Its pre-QAT/PTQ versus per-arm post-training provenance is also unstated; this is the remaining F1 scope/interpretation gap.

F2 is repaired. L_train is now an executable scalar mean over every native prefix step and selected channel. F1 remains open for V_visit: its diagnostic formula lacks temporal reduction and does not identify whether values come from a fixed pre-QAT/PTQ reference or each arm after training.
